result:
**Verdict for DG4 round 3 (qa-verifier): PASS, with no new findings.** I reviewed the frozen candidate `sha256:890faa12…` (1,459 files, source `925f0bc`). The recomputed ID matched at the start and end, in the repository and in three complete disposable clones.

**The two round-2 repairs work as required:**
- **F-DG4-122:** the value gap shows as "100 %", never as a money amount. This holds on T10, the Executive Overview and the Finance dashboard, in English and Arabic.
- **F-DG4-123:** the value headlines are on the profit-and-cash basis (90). Top line (300) and non-cash (45) appear beside them, labelled and never added together (435 appears nowhere). This holds on all four surfaces. `p4-value-headlines` test 2 ran and passed in both language projects.
- **My extra probes all pass (6/6, run twice):**
  - Every headline drills to records that add up to it, and the Finance gross line now drills and sums to exactly 95.
  - A gap of 0.666667 ignores the top line.
  - Users without access get 404.
  - Malformed drill-down requests are refused (400 or 422).
  - A missing amount shows as Unknown, never 0 or green.
  - The Q1 filter changes all three bases.
- **The re-baselined tests:** the two QA tests and `p4-dashboards` test 4b still test their requirements word for word.

**Results across the rest of the review:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Static checks (7) | all exit 0 |
| Unit tests, Node 22 and 24, locale unset and C.UTF-8 | 2819 + 259 passed in each; 2 skips by design |
| Integration, run twice | 1960/1960 each; 61 migrations, 652 operations, all pending lists empty |
| `tests/qa` on its own | 172/172 |
| REQ-DLV-036 (A04, A09, A10, A11) | 85/85, plus the A04 and A08/A09 browser tests in both languages |
| My read-only auditor screen sweep | 513 checks per language, 0 failed: accessibility (axe), 390 px and 200 % text |
| Validators (register, pipeline, historical DG3/DG2/DG1) | all PASS |
| Requirement trace | all 137 rows have a passing test in this round's logs |

**Failures and problems in my own runs, all explained in `RUN-NOTES.md` and the record:**
- **One product-side non-pass:** the P2 journey test "Define → G2" hit its 30-second limit under load in every full browser run. No DG4 requirement cites it, and it passed 24/24 when run alone in each locale. Decisions D-111, D-112 and D-115 already record this.
- **Integration run 2 restarted:** the first copy was stopped because I started it without a time limit. I re-ran it in full.
- **Two browser runs collided:** I wrongly thought the first locale-unset run had died, because the sandbox hides other tasks' processes. It overlapped the second run in the same copy. This caused one missing-file error in the first run and left my spec's Arabic half unrun in the second. A solo re-run passed 32/32.
- **My own probe bugs:** the first two probe runs failed because of mistakes in my test, not the product, and were then fixed. The product correctly returned 422 where I had wrongly expected 400.

**Observation, not a finding:** when a currency has only revenue-uplift or avoided-cost benefits, the Finance gross line shows a known zero beside a "not applicable" headline. The implementer disclosed this as a design choice; it is a true empty sum, and the call belongs to the domain reviewer.

The review record (schema-valid) and its narrative are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG4/round-3/`; it has no findings sidecar since there are no findings. All evidence is under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/qa/round-3/`, and my two test files are under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/qa/tests/round-3/`. I removed the disposable clones. `git status` shows the other reviewers' round-3 records as deleted: this is the protocol's staging view, which hides other reviewers' records during my run. I did not touch them.
